the merchant's POD products (print areas, variants, prices)

fields.name: token
fields.help: Printify personal access token (My profile > Connections) sent as `Authorization: Bearer`.

config_fields.name: shop_id
config_fields.help: Printify shop id (from GET /v1/shops.json); required by get_order and create_order, which are per shop.

me.note: GET /v1/shops.json lists the merchant's shops [{id, title, sales_channel}]; take the shop id from here for the shop_id setting.

list_products.note: Blank-product catalogue (blueprints [{id, title, brand, model, images[]}]); unpaginated, the full list is returned and `query`/`category` are not accepted by the endpoint. Catalog calls are limited to 100/minute.

get_product.note: One blueprint; variants and prices are per print provider (GET /v1/catalog/blueprints/{id}/print_providers/{ppid}/variants.json, not mapped).

create_order.note: POST /v1/shops/{shop_id}/orders.json creates the order in the shop; it is NOT submitted for production (a separate documented call), so nothing is charged by this tool. `items` are Printify line_items [{product_id, variant_id, quantity}], `shipping_address` is address_to {first_name, last_name, email, phone, country, region, address1, address2, city, zip}, `shipping_option` is the numeric shipping_method id from the shipping estimate. Needs the shop_id setting.

get_order.note: GET /v1/shops/{shop_id}/orders/{order_id}.json: {id, status, total_price, total_shipping, created_at, shipments[{carrier, number, url, delivered_at}]}; amounts are integers in cents. Needs the shop_id setting.

not_offered.quote_shipping: POST /v1/shops/{shop_id}/orders/shipping.json takes nested line_items[{product_id, variant_id, quantity}] + address_to{country, region, ...}; the vocabulary's product_id/country/quantity cannot be shaped into that body by the runtime's flat body form.
not_offered.track: No tracking-events endpoint; shipments[{carrier, number, url, delivered_at}] are part of the order record (see get_order).

evidence: host api.printify.com: DNS ok, TLSv1.3 (Let's Encrypt)
probe: 5/5 tools answered on their documented path with an auth refusal, a validation error or data; control route -> 404 (not_found), so the answers are path-specific
HTML docs spot-check (render-doc): 5/5 tool paths found verbatim on their docs pages; every parameter and body key named on the page
live read without credentials: list_products returned data that validates against the vocabulary
